
```{r}
library(terra)
library(modifiedmk)

climate_dir <- "~/SeasonalTrendsEdited/data/TerraClimate"
out_dir <- "~/SeasonalTrendsEdited/output"

climate_stacks <- list(
  precipitation = list(
    long = rast(
      file.path(
        climate_dir,
        "long_season_precipitation_1997_2024.tif"
      )
    ),
    short = rast(
      file.path(
        climate_dir,
        "short_season_precipitation_1997_2024.tif"
      )
    )
  ),

  temperature = list(
    long = rast(
      file.path(
        climate_dir,
        "long_season_temperature_1997_2024.tif"
      )
    ),
    short = rast(
      file.path(
        climate_dir,
        "short_season_temperature_1997_2024.tif"
      )
    )
  ),

  solar_radiation = list(
    long = rast(
      file.path(
        climate_dir,
        "long_season_solar_radiation_1997_2024.tif"
      )
    ),
    short = rast(
      file.path(
        climate_dir,
        "short_season_solar_radiation_1997_2024.tif"
      )
    )
  ),

  vpd = list(
    long = rast(
      file.path(
        climate_dir,
        "long_season_vpd_1997_2024.tif"
      )
    ),
    short = rast(
      file.path(
        climate_dir,
        "short_season_vpd_1997_2024.tif"
      )
    )
  ),

  soil_moisture = list(
    long = rast(
      file.path(
        climate_dir,
        "long_season_soil_moisture_1997_2024.tif"
      )
    ),
    short = rast(
      file.path(
        climate_dir,
        "short_season_soil_moisture_1997_2024.tif"
      )
    )
  )
)


# Ordinary Mann-Kendall + Sen's slope
ordinary_mk_fun <- function(x) {

  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    return(c(
      slope = NA_real_,
      pvalue = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  x <- x[!is.na(x)]

  if (length(x) < 10) {
    return(c(
      slope = NA_real_,
      pvalue = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  mk <- try(
    suppressWarnings(
      modifiedmk::mkttest(x)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (inherits(mk, "try-error")) {
    return(c(
      slope = NA_real_,
      pvalue = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  # [[2]] = Sen's slope
  # [[5]] = ordinary MK p-value
  slope <- as.numeric(
    mk[[2]]
  )

  pvalue <- as.numeric(
    mk[[5]]
  )

  if (!is.finite(slope)) {
    slope <- NA_real_
  }

  if (!is.finite(pvalue)) {
    pvalue <- NA_real_
  }

  return(c(
    slope = slope,
    pvalue = pvalue
  ))
}


# Hamed-Rao modified Mann-Kendall + Sen's slope
modified_mk_fun <- function(x) {

  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    return(c(
      slope = NA_real_,
      pvalue = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  x <- x[!is.na(x)]

  if (length(x) < 10) {
    return(c(
      slope = NA_real_,
      pvalue = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  mk <- try(
    suppressWarnings(
      modifiedmk::mmkh3lag(x)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (inherits(mk, "try-error")) {
    return(c(
      slope = NA_real_,
      pvalue = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  # [[7]] = Sen's slope
  # [[2]] = corrected p-value
  slope <- as.numeric(
    mk[[7]]
  )

  pvalue <- as.numeric(
    mk[[2]]
  )

  if (!is.finite(slope)) {
    slope <- NA_real_
  }

  if (!is.finite(pvalue)) {
    pvalue <- NA_real_
  }

  return(c(
    slope = slope,
    pvalue = pvalue
  ))
}


# Climate trend classification
# 1 = significant decrease
# 2 = no significant trend
# 3 = significant increase

trend_class_fun <- function(x) {

  slope <- x[1]
  pvalue <- x[2]

  if (is.na(slope) || is.na(pvalue)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  if (pvalue < 0.05 && slope < 0) {
    return(1)
  }

  if (pvalue < 0.05 && slope > 0) {
    return(3)
  }

  return(2)
}


mk_methods <- data.frame(
  variable = c(
    "precipitation",
    "precipitation",
    "temperature",
    "temperature",
    "solar_radiation",
    "solar_radiation",
    "vpd",
    "vpd",
    "soil_moisture",
    "soil_moisture"
  ),

  season = c(
    "long",
    "short",
    "long",
    "short",
    "long",
    "short",
    "long",
    "short",
    "long",
    "short"
  ),

  method = c(
    "ordinary",
    "ordinary",
    "ordinary",
    "ordinary",
    "ordinary",
    "ordinary",
    "modified",
    "ordinary",
    "ordinary",
    "ordinary"
  )
)


all_freq <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(mk_methods))) {

  variable <- mk_methods$variable[i]
  season <- mk_methods$season[i]
  method <- mk_methods$method[i]

  x <- climate_stacks[[variable]][[season]]

  cat(
    "\nRunning",
    variable,
    "-",
    season,
    "-",
    method,
    "MK\n"
  )

  if (method == "modified") {

    mk_result <- app(
      x,
      fun = modified_mk_fun
    )

  } else {

    mk_result <- app(
      x,
      fun = ordinary_mk_fun
    )
  }

  names(mk_result) <- c(
    "Sen_slope",
    "p_value"
  )

  writeRaster(
    mk_result,
    file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(
        season,
        "_season_",
        variable,
        "_MK_results.tif"
      )
    ),
    overwrite = TRUE,
    wopt = list(
      datatype = "FLT4S",
      filetype = "GTiff"
    )
  )

  trend_class <- app(
    mk_result,
    fun = trend_class_fun
  )

  names(trend_class) <- "Trend_class"

  writeRaster(
    trend_class,
    file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(
        season,
        "_season_",
        variable,
        "_MK_trend_class.tif"
      )
    ),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )

  f <- freq(trend_class)

  f <- f[
    !is.na(f$value),
  ]

  f$percentage <-
    f$count /
    sum(f$count) * 100

  f$variable <- variable
  f$season <- season
  f$method <- method

  all_freq[[paste(variable, season, sep = "_")]] <- f

  print(f)
}


mk_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  all_freq
)

mk_summary$class <- ifelse(
  mk_summary$value == 1,
  "Significant decrease",
  ifelse(
    mk_summary$value == 2,
    "No significant trend",
    "Significant increase"
  )
)

mk_summary <- mk_summary[
  ,
  c(
    "variable",
    "season",
    "method",
    "value",
    "class",
    "count",
    "percentage"
  )
]

write.csv(
  mk_summary,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "climate_MK_class_percentages.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(mk_summary)
```
